Student Loan Calculator

Find your student loan payoff date from a monthly payment, or the payment needed for any term.

Assumes fixed rate and on-time payments with no extra principal payments.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a mode: payoff time from your payment, or payment from a term.
  2. Enter the balance and interest rate.
  3. Read the payoff date, total interest or required payment.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is payoff time calculated?

From n = −ln(1 − r·P / payment) / ln(1 + r), the standard amortization inversion, where r is the monthly rate.

What if my payment barely covers interest?

If the payment is at or below the monthly interest charge, the balance never shrinks — the tool will warn you to raise it.

Does this handle variable rates?

No. It assumes the fixed rate you enter for the whole payoff period.
